comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Looks as if this will be craftable through Aide Quarters Production sometime after the Atlantis expansion is released.

Source: gvdb.mydns.jp/db/module/TradeDB/action/ItemShow?id=3278

It'll require R13 Handi (player skill AND reserve aide Handi level; +1 Handi skill on an Aide gives them a boost of 5 to their Handi), and each production requires materials of x1 Athena's Tree and x2 "Wings of Icarus", which will be obtained from the Labyrinth dungeon. Possibly the new Adept of Ages title will be needed, too.
